description: A method in a class body may declare its receiver as a leading self parameter, and its calls pass no receiver
def __init__ with a leading self declares the init constructor that the class runs
An arrow method with a self receiver returns its expression
this is an equal spelling of the receiver parameter
Literal defaults and a final rest parameter follow the receiver
code:
class Order:
    def __init__(self, item, qty = 1, ...notes):
        self.item = item
        self.qty = qty
        self.notes = notes
order = Order("pen")
bulk = Order("ink", 5, "fragile", "gift")
[order.qty, order.notes, bulk.qty, bulk.notes]

description: Initializing parameters may follow the receiver of __init__
Named constructor arguments bind to the parameters after the receiver
A subclass written with extends passes its arguments to the parent constructor through super
Class-level rules follow properties that a self parameter method changes
def __init__ without a receiver stays an ordinary method that construction does not run
